description: Instant replay, game recording and clip editing for Windows games.
notes: The official Kairos-Setup.exe is an Inno Setup 6 wrapper that launches Velopack Setup. This manifest does not run either installer: it extracts the official full.nupkg application payload from lib/app.

The payload is self-contained for .NET but requires the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 runtime (14.50 or newer). The extras/vcredist2022 dependency supplies the x64 runtime; add the Extras bucket if it is not already configured.

KAIROS_DATA redirects settings, logs, voice data, and replay working files into Scoop's persistent data directory. User-created clips remain in the configured clips folder (Videos/Kairos by default), outside the Scoop app directory.
Because this extracted copy is not registered as a Velopack installation, Kairos disables its in-app updater. Use 'scoop update kairos' to update it. Exit Kairos before updating or uninstalling.
